source.numeric_order: Original source RGB8 planar cubes and GRB shaper banks; only smoothed formed-code/AP1 response tables are current catalogue assets.

rights: Derived numeric inputs from Fujifilm Frontier350/370 parameter data. Source availability is not redistribution permission; public asset clearance remains separate from local application verification.

runtime_definitions.ownership: Executable files contain current parameters only. This provenance records rationale/source evidence and is not part of a runtime calibration parser or model fingerprint.

positive_input.basis: Fixed standard AP1/D60 to floating-point linear Rec.709/sRGB D65, Bradford adaptation. No sRGB transfer encoding or input clipping.
positive_input.encoding: Radial mixed-drive compression -> shared reference-negative characteristic -> per-bank diagonal neutral slopes -> grey-centred native codes.
positive_input.neutral_calibration: Three code slopes per bank calibrated on neutral exposures with a soft baseline-brightness penalty; not photographic or colour-matrix fitting.

stock_input.formation: Nominal, paper-independent Spektrafilm exposure/development and source dye/base spectra.
stock_input.readout: Base-relative spectral scanner OD, centred at nominal scene grey; mean(Dgrey)/Dgrey channel balance retains density strength. Identity cross-channel mixing and per-bank diagonal neutral slopes.
stock_input.neutral_calibration: One shared three-channel slope vector per bank, calibrated jointly across all16 stocks with a soft own-baseline brightness penalty; no per-stock normalization.
stock_input.sensor_status: Approximate digitization of attributed SP3000 illumination, original measurement provenance unverified; detector/optics treated constant within each band

tone_reference.stock_scale: Generic-reference Frontier/A neutral exposure curve aligned to Fuji Crystal Archive TypeII/None over33 exposures from-5to+3EV. Selected stocks inherit the density readout, not individually fitted tone curves.
tone_reference.positive_scale: Already-positive encoding aligned to that frozen neutral reference, with separate bank neutral slopes.
tone_reference.rendering: Native A/B last, without output gamma or pedestal subtraction. Grey anchors fix scene18%grey; off-axis stock neutral curves, native floors and colour-brightness coupling remain.

response_derivation.input_allocation: uniform formed native code; preparation evaluates formation before sampling this source volume
response_derivation.source_shaper_interpretation: Exact first constant source interval, C1 monotone Hermite joins and original grey ordinate; rational upper continuation toward960; authored interpretation of source quantization
response_derivation.inverse_reference: Pinned OCIO2.6.0 sRGB100nit ACES inverse to AP1 before response smoothing

Gaussian.boundary: difference-form odd reflection at lower code boundaries, constant upper extension
Gaussian.space: AP1 volume over formed code coordinates
